body: An `ERR_NOT_ON_RENDER_THREAD` check might be a nice addition to the start of these functions?

These are private functions that can't be called directly from the outside. I'd personally only use `ERR_NOT_ON_RENDER_THREAD` in order to protect a function that an external developer could accidentally call from the wrong thread. Adding it here would just be protecting `OpenXRCompositionLayerExtension` from itself, which I don't think we need to do

We need something better for this, if vendors introduce vendor extensions for composition layers, we can't use this system for that. There is also a risk if any composition layer needs things in their next pointers and that data doesn't get copied along.

This is why for spatial entities I introduced `OpenXRStructureBase` as a refcounted wrapper class for these types of structures.

We simply need to define a `OpenXRCompositionLayerBaseHeader` abstract class that subclasses `OpenXRStructureBase` and then create subclasses for each composition layer type.

It's a much cleaner approach, allows for using additional wrapper classes for anything in the next chain, and allows us to support vendor composition layers down the line.

Similar to my previous remark, this needs to become more generic. If we're going down the path of using `OpenXRStructureBase` as I suggested, we could simply create a `set_pose` (or probably better a `set_transform` so it can be exposed to GDExtensions) on `OpenXRCompositionLayerBaseHeader` as a virtual method that we implement on each subclass.
Though I must admit, I have no idea on how we can make these more generic and future proof...

> We need something better for this, if vendors introduce vendor extensions for composition layers, we can't use this system for that.
> There is also a risk if any composition layer needs things in their next pointers and that data doesn't get copied along.

We already have a system for putting things into the next pointer of the composition layers provided by this class: it's via the `OpenXRExtensionWrapper::set_viewport_composition_layer_and_get_next_pointer()` virtual method. We're already using it a bunch from the godot_openxr_vendors repo!
